checkpoints.position: After successful real prepare/plan staging, before any canonical mutation. Do not turn read-only prepare() into a writer.

After actual ChangeSet/outcome preparation that exists on this path, before applyPreparedPlan. Declare exactly which resources are prepared; this is not evidence that the future FC08 F/U admission exists.
After internal preflight, immediately before the first ObjectStoreMutator write, while live objects/manifest/ledger/generation/clock are still before-state. No callback between individual writes.
After input admission and immediately before entries_.reserve; failure uses the existing nullopt path and preserves cursor/redo.
After real reservation and successful construction of the temporary PreparedEntry, before returning it or publishing History. Failure discards the temporary; no cursor or redo change.

After actual History entry preparation and before OperationEngine::apply. Correlate the same command/operation/owner and record the actual prepared basis. Do not add commitPrepared to OperationEngine or implement the future AdmittedUndoableCommand.
After objects/manifest/ledger/generation/clock and commit record are fully published, before downstream Scene processing.
After an existing History transition; observe cursor, entry identity and redo suffix without adding or changing entries.

hook_constraints: Use instance-scoped lifetime-safe registration and full operation/request/owner identity, not process-wide mutable nth-allocation state. Clear armed faults at completion/cancel/detach; no cross-owner leakage.

Observer callbacks are bounded, noexcept, non-reentrant and read-only. They do not receive mutable stores or submit ports. Capture coherent before/after values through existing reads or qualification-only friend read access; no direct canonical or History writes.

A selected one-shot precommit rejection follows an existing failure return and destroys temporary preparation. After the first live mutation there is no injected failure, pause, observer of a partial state, or rollback-by-test.
Observe actual reached phases; never emit a future phase merely because its name is requested. Distinguish resources actually reserved from the future accepted E01 outcome/F/U reservation.

Scheduling H06 uses separate legitimate owner operations at existing safe boundaries, not reentrant writes from an observer. If a resumable admitted-plan boundary is absent, mark that future product execution nonpassing rather than implement it inside the hook.
No fake submit/coordinator, no direct store mutation, no new ObjectKind/opcode17/18, no production container intent/API, no changing existing apply/History algorithms to make a probe pass.
materialization_vs_product: Bind and exercise hooks on valid existing operations and real EditorHistory/Runtime owners. These are instrumented-baseline observations, never FC08 product PASS.

For FC08-only target/API/F-U rebinding phases absent in the baseline, preserve the exact case/variant and accepted future seam with CAPABILITY_ABSENT/NOT_REACHED_BASELINE. Such records do not satisfy product positives and cannot hide a missing observation seam for an existing stage.

M03 may close when its real baseline bindings, live qualification hooks, complete oracle/discovery and explicit future-capability mapping are complete; it does not require implementing the future product first. H06 remains fully required for the later product package.
